description: Change a fact that is no longer true. Replaces the line containing old_text with new_text and moves the old line to History with today's date. Use this instead of deleting.

new_text.description: The new fact (plain sentence; date added for you). Empty string to retire the fact without a replacement.

old_text.description: A unique piece of the line to replace

source.description: Where the new fact came from

name: update_fact
